title: Gregory of Nyssa, Against Eunomius (2)
english: I read another treatise by the same Gregory of Nyssa on the same subject. In this he joins issue with Eunomius by more reasoned arguments and storms the tottering ramparts of his impiety. The beauty of his style, its mingled brilliancy and charm, are equally conspicuous in this work.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 7 of 279; Second treatise of Gregory of Nyssa against Eunomius; more logical/refutation-focused than the first.
